content.title: Blue Graphic Anime Promo | Character Lock and Title Return
content.summary: An adult percussionist drives a coral-black concert announcement through four actions. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult animated identity anchors all graphic chapters. + Each graphic burst follows one readable action. + Short exact typography remains legible and does not mutate. + Detail crops reconnect to the complete character. + The final title frame restores the complete character and the opening graphic language.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult animated percussionist with coral curls, green eyes, a black jumpsuit and ivory boots on a cream field. A running cross-step leads into one bounded landing that triggers black rays and the exact word "HOLD". Return her beneath the exact title "CORAL SIGNAL" and the small line "ONE NIGHT ONLY".

Each graphic burst follows one readable action.
Detail crops reconnect to the complete character.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult percussionist drives a coral-black concert announcement through four actions. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.

invariants.rule: One adult animated identity anchors all graphic chapters.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult animated identity anchors all graphic chapters."

invariants.rule: Each graphic burst follows one readable action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each graphic burst follows one readable action."

invariants.rule: Short exact typography remains legible and does not mutate.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Short exact typography remains legible and does not mutate."

invariants.rule: Detail crops reconnect to the complete character.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Detail crops reconnect to the complete character."

invariants.rule: The final title frame restores the complete character and the opening graphic language.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final title frame restores the complete character and the opening graphic language."
